title: Detailed backpack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <!-- bottom trim -->
  <path d='M28 82 Q50 88 72 82 L70 85 Q50 91 30 85 Z' fill='#2e6ab0'/>

  <line x1='28' y1='38' x2='28' y2='78' stroke='#7bc0ff' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='3,3'/>
  <!-- decorative stitching right -->
  <line x1='72' y1='38' x2='72' y2='78' stroke='#7bc0ff' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='3,3'/>
